title: Cookie Policy for AfriNuts Export
description: Our Cookies Policy explains how AfriNuts uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, improve our services, and analyze website traffic while protecting your privacy.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, improve user experience, and deliver relevant content. We use both first-party cookies (set by AfriNuts Export) and third-party cookies (set by analytics, marketing, or service providers).

essential.title: a. Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are strictly necessary for the basic operation of our website. They enable core services such as authentication, security, network management, and accessibility.

performance.title: b. Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies collect anonymous data about how visitors interact with our site to help improve website functionality and understand user behavior.
examples: Tools used: Google Analytics or similar
Data: Page views, click patterns, bounce rates
Used only in aggregated and anonymized form

functional.title: c. Functional Cookies
functional.description: Functional cookies remember your choices (such as language or region) and enhance your experience.
examples: Disabling may limit some site functionality

advertising.title: d. Advertising Cookies
advertising.description: Advertising cookies may be used by us or our marketing partners to personalize content or show relevant ads.
examples: Currently, we do not run third-party ads but may use them in the future
These cookies do not collect personally identifiable information without consent

managingPreferences.title: 3. Managing Cookie Preferences
managingPreferences.description: You can manage or change your cookie settings at any time using our Cookie Preferences Center or via your browser settings.
steps: Adjust settings for each type of cookie: Essential (locked), Performance, Functional, Advertising
managingPreferences.note: Disabling non-essential cookies may reduce functionality or user experience on our website.

thirdPartyCookies.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
thirdPartyCookies.description: Some cookies may be set by trusted third-party services we use to analyze traffic or enhance functionality. These third parties may collect information about your device and online activity. We ensure that all third-party partners comply with relevant data protection regulations such as GDPR and CCPA.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.description: Cookies have varying lifespans: Session cookies expire when you close your browser, whereas persistent cookies remain on your device for a defined period or until manually deleted. We regularly review our cookies to ensure they are relevant and comply with privacy laws.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.description: You have the following rights regarding your personal data and cookie usage:
items: Access and correct personal information collected via cookies
Withdraw consent for non-essential cookies at any time
Object to or restrict processing of your data where permitted
Lodge a complaint with a data protection authority if needed

childrenPrivacy.title: 7. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.description: Our website and services are not directed to children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from children and encourage parents or guardians to monitor their children's online activity.

changesToPolicy.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changesToPolicy.description: AfriNuts Export may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal obligations. Updates will be posted with the revised 'Last Updated' date. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of any changes.
